name: MITF-M melanocyte program for pigment production
rationale: All members are MITF-M target programs or melanocyte/melanin processes (melanin synthesis, pigment granules, UV/blue-light response, melanocyte differentiation); unlike confusables, which add MITF-M cell-cycle and DNA-repair targets, this theme carries melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization and light response.

name: Epithelial salt and water homeostasis under osmotic stress
rationale: Members are ion transport and homeostasis processes (cation-chloride cotransporters, K+ channels, renal Na+ transport, water and anion homeostasis); distinct from confusables by hyperosmotic, hypotonic and salt-stress responses, paracellular transport and SLC26A3/Ca2+-activated K+ channels rather than Na+/H+ exchangers, P-type ATPases or aldosterone/blood pressure control.

qualifier: from ER insertion to COPII export
name: Early secretory pathway from ER insertion to COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored protein insertion into the ER, ER retention and COPII cargo export to Golgi; confusables add ER folding, COPI retrograde traffic or ERAD, or lack the COPII export arm, while this theme has multi-pass membrane insertion and connexin oligomerization.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling with SERCA reuptake control
rationale: Members all concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ by SR/ER sequestration, Na+/Ca2+ exchange and ryanodine-receptor release restraint; distinct from confusables by regulation of SR calcium import and ATPase-coupled calcium pumping, and from the cardiac confusable by lacking cardiac contraction terms.

name: Erythroid differentiation through terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and differentiation (TAL1-GFI1B program, terminal erythroid membrane remodeling, regulation of erythrocyte differentiation); confusables instead carry stem/progenitor hematopoiesis or megakaryocyte development; one TAK1-ATF module is a loose fit.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis by ornithine transcarbamylase
rationale: Members are urea cycle, citrulline and arginine biosynthesis and OTC deficiency variants; the OTC deficiency members distinguish it from confusables carrying other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ornithine/ammonium handling.

name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members are host antimicrobial effector processes (metal sequestration, cytolysis, neutrophil cytotoxicity, killing of other organisms) with antifungal and Gram-positive defense; confusables emphasise degranulation, respiratory burst/Gram-negative killing or mucosal agglutination and nutrient-iron assimilation.

name: Hexose uptake and glycogen storage
rationale: Members span dietary carbohydrate digestion, intestinal/renal hexose transport and their defects, plus glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases; confusables have only one of the two arms (glycolysis/gluconeogenesis-linked glycogen, or galactose/urate transport), so the combination itself distinguishes.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling as cancer tumor suppressor
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor/SMAD signaling and its regulation; distinct from confusables by cancer-associated TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 mutants and RUNX3 tumor-suppressor targets (BIM, p21, ARF).

core: B and T cell receptor signaling
name: B and T cell receptor signaling with inhibitory co-receptors
rationale: Members are BCR and TCR proximal signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition (CTLA4, BTLA, CD22, PECAM1, negative regulation of BCR/TCR signaling); confusables are T cell-only or add positive BCR regulation and RAS activation.

qualifier: of neutral amino acids and peptides
name: Renal-intestinal solute carriers for neutral amino acids and peptides
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of amino acids, oligopeptides, urate, glucose and organic anions with their aminoaciduria/glucosuria/hypouricemia defects; distinct from confusables by the neutral amino acid and di/oligopeptide carriers, rather than hexose absorption, organic cations or cationic amino acids.

name: Angiogenic vessel remodeling of endothelium and smooth muscle
rationale: Members regulate vessel growth and remodeling: VEGF/VEGFR, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis and phenotypic switching; the largest confusable lacks the smooth muscle arm and the others lack VEGF/endothelial angiogenesis.

name: Amino acid turnover with tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic and biosynthetic processes (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, tyrosine, phenylalanine); tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from three confusables, while proline/glycine metabolism separates it from the phenylalanine/PKU confusable.

name: Osteoblast commitment from mesenchymal progenitors under Wnt control
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation (RUNX2, Wnt, BMP module, mechanical PIEZO1 signaling); confusables extend into mineralization, chondrocytes or osteoclasts and lack Wnt-antagonist and PIEZO1 members.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signaling
rationale: Members are B cell development, homeostasis, proliferation and BCR signal transduction (BTK, CD22, RAS, second messengers); confusables focus on germinal center, plasma and memory B cell or T cell programs without the BCR signaling cascade; a myeloid module is a loose fit.

name: MECP2 repressive control of neuronal gene expression
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, Rett-associated MECP2 loss-of-function variants and its neuronal targets plus Rett-relevant sensory functions; distinct from confusables by HDAC/NCoR co-repression and repression of translation and calcium-channel activity rather than locomotor and vocal behaviors.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle regulation
name: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle with termination control
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, elongation and termination, R-loop processing and transcription-factor control; distinct from confusables by termination and R-loop members, versus elongation pausing, MYC targets, Polycomb chromatin or RNA processing.

core: Striated muscle SR calcium release control
name: Muscle calcium release control damping cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate sequestered-calcium release, ryanodine receptors and Ca2+ extrusion in cardiac and skeletal muscle; distinct from confusables by negative regulation of cardiac contraction and heart rate and cardiac relaxation, rather than positive inotropy or SERCA reuptake.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptotic effectors
rationale: Members are p53 transcriptional targets in apoptosis (PUMA, NOXA, caspases, death receptors) and the BH3-only/cytochrome c release they trigger; confusables carry BAX/BAK/MOMP, DNA-damage signaling or anoikis instead.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members are ovarian follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle; confusables add FSH/LH secretion and response and lack luteolysis and oocyte meiotic maturation.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport by sodium-coupled carriers
rationale: Members are plasma membrane amino acid transport and transporter defects (SLC6A19, SLC6A14, SLC1A1, proton-coupled carriers); distinct from confusables by SLC6A14 and SLC1A1 sodium-coupled carriers and absence of peptide and iminoglycinuria transporters.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organization for spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and astral microtubules; distinct from confusables by spindle positioning/orientation and asymmetric division rather than cytokinesis rings, centriole duplication or neuronal migration.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretion toward the plasma membrane; confusables instead carry Golgi-lysosome and retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic or Rab/ARF signaling.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and adaptation with enhanced contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and survival; distinct from the closest confusable by positive regulation of contraction force and heart rate, and from the others by being cardiac/striated rather than vascular smooth muscle.

name: Golgi structural remodeling with membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and vesicle budding; membrane tubulation members distinguish it from confusables carrying COPI traffic, Golgi retention or constitutive secretion.

name: DNA base lesion repair with direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair steps and glycosylase defects plus ALKBH2/3 and MGMT direct reversal; alkylation reversal distinguishes it from confusables that add NEIL3 crosslink, mismatch or single-strand break repair.

name: Rho and Cdc42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C/D/G/J and CDC42 GTPase cycles and formin activation; confusables center on RAC, RND/ROCK/PAK or IQGAP effectors and lack RhoA-C or formins.

name: Hepatic bilirubin clearance from heme breakdown
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole degradation, UGT1A conjugation, OATP1B uptake and ABCC2 export with their hyperbilirubinemias; confusables share organic anion transport but concern drug ADME and xenobiotic handling.

name: Iminoglycinuria from renal proline-glycine transporter defects
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables are broader amino acid, hexose or urate transport themes.

name: Motor control behavior with cerebellar-striatal development
rationale: Members are locomotion, voluntary movement, righting reflex, proprioception and motor learning with cerebellar and striatal development; confusables add vocal, auditory and social behaviors or glial/precursor cerebellar development; one neuronal RNA-binding module is a loose fit.
